scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: Unital endomorphisms of truncated coordinate-cross commutative local algebras for n>=2 and d in {2,3,4}; reduced geometric loci and exact finite-field point counts, every characteristic.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Definitions and proof are self-contained; finite computational tests are corroboration only; originality is provisional.
limitations: Does not claim the nonreduced endomorphism scheme or scheme multiplicities.
Does not classify truncation lengths d>=5.
Previous work gives the exact automorphism group; its classification is not claimed as new.
Residual historical priority risk, no independent validation.

title: A first non-equidimensional threshold for endomorphism monoids of truncated coordinate crosses
